<a id="projectconf-monitor-eol"></a>

# `monitor_eol` {#monitor-eol}

- **Type:** String: `CR`, `LF`, `CRLF`
- **Multiple values:** No
- **Default:** `CRLF`

A monitor end of line mode. See [`pio device monitor --eol`](../../cli/pio-device/monitor.md#cmdoption-pio-device-monitor-eol).
